title: Tanzanian Coconut Squid
author: Chef Fatuma
desc: Tanzanian Ngisi wa Nazi — squid rings quickly sautéed in a fragrant coconut milk, garlic, and Zanzibar spice sauce. Light, aromatic, and very fast — the coastal squid curry that takes 15 minutes from start to finish.
longDesc: Coconut squid is the quick seafood dish of coastal Tanzania — squid from the morning's catch in a light coconut sauce in under 15 minutes. The key is speed — the squid goes in last and comes out quickly.
steps: Cook onions until golden. Add garlic, ginger, spices.
Add tomatoes. Cook 6 minutes until thick.
Add coconut milk. Bring to gentle simmer.
Add squid rings. Cook for exactly 3 minutes.
Add lemon juice and coriander. Remove from heat immediately.
chefTips: 3 minutes for squid — not a second more.
Have everything ready before squid goes in.
cookingScience: See TZA072 for squid cooking science.
sustainabilityTips: Fresh Indian Ocean squid from local fishermen.
culturalNote: Coconut squid demonstrates the Swahili coast philosophy — the best ingredients need the least interference.
